elements.element: Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor.
elements.evidence: Section 7.2 expressly states that Customer has no obligation to disclose, match, or extend favourable third-party offers or terms to Vendor; §12.3 also disclaims any most-favoured-customer commitment.

elements.element: The Customer MFN covers only a defined product.
elements.evidence: The rendered language eliminates the Customer MFN entirely rather than creating one limited to a defined product.

elements.element: The Customer MFN lasts no longer than 12 months.
elements.evidence: No Customer MFN or 12-month duration is stated because the MFN obligation is removed.

elements.element: The Customer MFN contains reasonable like-for-like comparison carve-outs.
elements.evidence: No Customer MFN or like-for-like comparison carve-outs are stated because the MFN obligation is removed.
